guidance.statement: NIM expected in the range of 3.65% to 3.70% in the next few quarters
ROA expected at 1.55% to 1.65% for FY27, with exit ROA of 1.60-1.65%
Cost-to-income ratio to remain in the range of 47% to 48% for FY27
Credit growth 2-3% above industry; MSME 55-60%, gold 31-32%, retail secured 10% of book
Slippages for the year in the range of Rs. 700 crores to Rs. 750 crores; credit cost 0.40% and slippage ratio 1.20-1.30%
ECLGS portfolio expected at Rs. 2,000 crores to Rs. 2,500 crores under the scheme

industry: Financial Services > Banks > Private Sector Bank

operating_notes.text: Provision coverage ratio was 84% including technical write-off and 65% excluding it as on March 31, 2026.
Capital adequacy ratio (Basel III) was 21.92% at Mar-2026 against 23.75% a year earlier.
The bank has no subsidiaries, associates or joint ventures as on March 31, 2026.
Bank opened 13 new branches on April 27, 2026, taking its total branch network to 1,000.
Gross NPA at 1.91% is the lowest in 11 years; net NPA at 0.68%.
SMA2 at 0.72% of advances, down from 1.59% in Q1FY26.
Gold loans constitute about 30% of advances, with per-gram lending capped at ~₹10,300.
Average MSME disbursal is around ₹3,500 Cr per quarter; MSME borrowers repay about ₹900 Cr a month.
Gold loan average LTV is 62.07%; a 20% fall in gold prices would take it to 78%.
Yield on advances 9.79%; yield on investments 6.42%, or 6.67% if ₹12 Cr of mutual fund income were booked as interest.

FY2021-22 GST demand from Deputy Commissioner, State Tax, Tanjore: tax ₹110.37 Cr plus interest and penalty ₹98.52 Cr, total ₹208.91 Cr, down from ₹337.79 Cr after remand by the Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court.

timeline.summary: City Union Bank Limited’s **Mr. Narayana** (Administrative Office) announces Q4 FY26 earnings call with Ambit Capital on **April 27, 2026**, via provided web link.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): interest earned ₹1,855.62 Cr (+21.1% YoY), net profit ₹359.56 Cr (+24.9% YoY).
City Union Bank opened 13 new branches on April 27, 2026, taking its total network to 1,000 branches.
City Union Bank Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4 & FY 2026 results via its website on April 27, 2026.

City Union Bank Limited’s Dr. N. Kamakodi (MD & CEO), Shri. R. Vijay Anandh, Shri. V. Ramesh (Executive Directors), and Shri J. Sadagopan (CFO) participated in Ambit Capital’s FY 2026 Earnings Call on April 27, 2026.
City Union Bank announced a postal ballot notice for a 1:3 bonus issue and the appointment of Shri R. Mohan as an Independent Director.
City Union Bank held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call on April 27, 2026, where it guided FY27 ROA to 1.65-1.67% and announced the opening of its 1,000th branch.
RBI approves Kotak Mahindra Bank to acquire up to 9.99% stake in City Union Bank
City Union Bank received an RBI penalty of ₹10.10 lakh on May 22, 2026, for priority sector loan and credit information reporting non-compliance.
City Union Bank Limited will participate in Axis Capital Rising Stars Conference 2026 on June 01, 2026, in Mumbai as per Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations.
City Union Bank Limited participated in Trinity India 2026 Annual Global Investor Conference on May 29, 2026, at Mumbai.
City Union Bank shareholders approved the appointment of Shri R Mohan as Independent Director and the issuance of bonus shares via postal ballot.
On 28 July 2026 City Union Bank reported Q1FY27 PAT of ₹383 Cr, up 25% YoY and its highest, with GNPA at 1.73% and advances up 25% to ₹67,645 Cr.
14 Oct 2026: City Union Bank received a remand GST order for FY2021-22 cutting the demand to ₹208.91 Cr from ₹337.79 Cr; the bank plans legal remedies.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): interest earned ₹2,092.25 Cr, net profit ₹415.91 Cr.
City Union Bank Limited hosted audio recording of its Q2 & H1 FY 2027 earnings call, available on its website, effective October 28, 2026.
City Union Bank Limited participated in the Q2 FY 2027 Earnings Call organized by Ambit Capital on October 28, 2026.
